221: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ; ਜੀਇ ਆਈ ਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
The Guru's teaching has proved effective in my soul. ॥1॥
ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ; ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
In this way, dwelling on the Lord, my mind is reconciled.
ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru's Word I have recognised the ointment of spiritual wisdom. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
My mind accepts the One peace, and has merged in poise.
The immaculate Bani has dispelled my doubt.
I am dyed a deep crimson; the colour of Maya now seems a pale, fleeting red.
His glance of grace fell upon me, and I have held back the poison. ॥2॥
My consciousness has turned around; dead while yet alive, I have awakened.
ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੇ; ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
Dwelling on the Word, my mind is attached to the Lord.
Gathering in the sublime essence, I have cast out and renounced the poison.
ਭਾਇ ਬਸੇ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਿਆ ॥੩॥
Abiding in His love, the fear of death has run away. ॥3॥
The craving for pleasures is gone, and so are strife and ego.
ਚਿਤੁ. ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ; ਹੁਕਮਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
My consciousness is imbued with the Lord, through the will of the Infinite One.
The rituals of caste and social honour are finished.
He has cast His glance of grace upon me, and peace is established in my soul. ॥4॥
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Without You, I see no friend at all.
Whom else should I serve? To whom should I give my consciousness?
Whom should I ask? At whose feet should I fall?
By whose teaching shall I remain lovingly attuned? ॥5॥
I serve the Guru, and I fall at the Guru's feet.
I worship Him with devotion, and I am absorbed in the Lord's Name.
Love (of the Lord) is my teaching, my initiation and my food.
By His will, through the union of destiny, I dwell in my own true home. ॥6॥
Pride is gone, and my attention rests in the peace of the soul.
The light has dawned, and I am absorbed in the Light.
The writing (of destiny) cannot be erased; the Word is my insignia.
I know the Creator to be the Doer of all. ॥7॥
I am not a pandit, nor clever, nor wise;
I do not stray, nor am I deluded by doubt.
I do not speak idle words; I have recognised His command.
O Nanak, through the Guru's teaching, I am absorbed in poise. ॥8॥1॥
The mind is an elephant in the forest of the body.
The Guru is the goad; when the True Word is the insignia,
one obtains glory and honour at the Court of the Lord King. ॥1॥
He cannot be known through cleverness.
ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਕਿਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without subduing the mind, how can its worth be assessed? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The nectar is in the home of the self, but the thief is stealing it away.
No one can say no to him.
He Himself protects us and blesses us with greatness. ॥2॥
Billions upon billions of fires (of desire) are in one place.
They are put out with water, when the Guru imparts understanding.
ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਲੀਆ; ਰਹਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੩॥
Giving my mind, I have obtained it, and I sing His praises with joy. ॥3॥
As it is at home, so it is outside.
Sitting in a cave, what can I say it has become?
In the ocean or on the mountain, it remains just as fearless (unrestrained). ॥4॥
Tell me, who can kill one who is already dead (to the self)?
What fear, and of what, can there be for one who is fearless?
Through the Word, he recognises the Lord in the three worlds. ॥5॥
One who merely speaks has only uttered words;
one who understands has recognised Him intuitively.
Seeing and reflecting, my mind is reconciled. ॥6॥
Glory, beauty and liberation are in the One Name.
There the Immaculate Lord is pervading.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਨਿਜ ਠਾਈ ॥੭॥
He dwells in the home of the self, in His own place. ॥7॥
So many silent sages praise Him with love.
222: ਤਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਚੈ; ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Pure in body and mind, they keep the True One in their consciousness.
O Nanak, meditate on the Lord forever and ever. ॥8॥2॥
ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
The mind does not die, and the task is not accomplished,
while the mind is under the power of the demons, evil-mindedness and duality.
ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
When the mind is reconciled through the Guru, it becomes one (with Him). ॥1॥
The Lord is beyond attributes, yet He is won over by virtue.
One who eradicates self-conceit contemplates Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The deluded mind thinks of all sorts of corruption.
When the mind is deluded, the load (of sin) falls on one's head.
When the mind is reconciled, it is attuned to the One Lord. ॥2॥
The deluded mind goes to the house of Maya.
Engrossed in lust, it does not stay in its place.
O mortal, meditate on the Lord, letting your tongue savour His essence. ॥3॥
Elephants, horses, gold, children and wife —
in great anxiety over them, one departs from the arena having lost.
It is a game of gambling, with unripe pieces. ॥4॥
As one amasses wealth, corruption grows;
joy and sorrow stand at one's door.
Peace comes with ease, meditating on the Lord within the heart. ॥5॥
When He casts His glance of grace, He unites one in union with Him.
One gathers virtues and burns away faults through the Word.
The Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Name. ॥6॥
Without the Name, all pain abides.
The consciousness of the foolish self-willed one dwells in Maya.
Through the Guru, one obtains spiritual wisdom, written by grace from the Primal Lord. ॥7॥
The fickle mind runs and runs after fleeting things.
The True, Pure One is not pleased by filth.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh sings the Lord's praises. ॥8॥3॥
Acting in ego, peace is not obtained.
The mind's intellect is false; only the Lord is True.
All who love duality are ruined.
People act as they are pre-ordained. ॥1॥
I have seen the world to be such a gambler:
ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਗੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
all beg for peace, but they forget the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If the Unseen Lord could be seen, then He could be described.
Without seeing Him, all such talk is useless.
To the Gurmukh He is seen, with intuitive ease.
With awareness, he serves, lovingly attuned to the One. ॥2॥
Begging for peace, one receives severe pain,
weaving a garland of all corruptions.
ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ. ਝੂਠੇ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without the One, the false find no liberation.
The Creator created the creation, and He watches over it. ॥3॥
The fire of craving is quenched by the Word;
duality and doubt are dispelled in poise and love.
Through the Guru's teaching, the Name dwells in the heart.
Through the True Bani, one sings the Lord's praises. ॥4॥
The True One is within the body; the Gurmukh loves Him.
Without the Name, one finds no place of rest.
The Beloved Lord King is devoted to love;
when He casts His glance of grace, one understands the Name. ॥5॥
Attachment to Maya is total entanglement.
The self-willed one is filthy, cursed and dreadful.
Serving the True Guru, the entanglements end;
in the Ambrosial Name one abides in peace forever. ॥6॥
The Gurmukh understands, and is lovingly attuned to the One.
He dwells in his own true home, merged in the True One.
Coming and going in birth and death are brought to an end.
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੭॥
This understanding is obtained from the perfect Guru. ॥7॥
Speaking His sermon, I find no end to Him.
223: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
I have asked the Guru and seen that there is no other door.
Pain and pleasure come by His will and pleasure.
Nanak, the lowly, says this, lovingly attuned. ॥8॥4॥
Maya, which separates from God, dwells in the consciousness of the world.
Through lust, anger and ego, one is destroyed. ॥1॥
Whom should I call a second, when there is none other?
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ; ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In all is the One Immaculate Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The evil-minded intellect of duality speaks of two;
such a one comes and goes, dies, and remains in duality. ॥2॥
On earth and in the sky, I see no second;
among women and men, throughout the world, there is only He. ॥3॥
I behold the sun and moon, the lamps of the world;
within all is my ever-youthful Beloved. ॥4॥
In His mercy, He attached my consciousness to Himself;
the True Guru has made me understand the One. ॥5॥
The Gurmukh knows the One Immaculate Lord;
subduing duality, he recognises Him through the Word. ॥6॥
The command of the One Lord prevails throughout all the worlds;
from the One, all have arisen. ॥7॥
There are two paths, but know that there is only One Master.
Through the Guru's Word, recognise His command. ॥8॥
He is pervading all forms, colours and minds.
Says Nanak, I praise the One alone. ॥9॥5॥
One who does deeds that elevate the soul is true (yogi).
What can the unripe one know of the secret of liberation? ॥1॥
Such is the yogi who contemplates the way:
ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ; ਸਾਚੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
subduing the five (passions), he enshrines the True One in his heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One within whom He enshrines the True Name
realises the worth of the way of union. ॥2॥
The sun and moon are one and the same to him, as are home and wilderness.
The praise of the Lord is his natural daily practice. ॥3॥
He begs for the alms of the One Word alone;
spiritual wisdom, meditation and the true way awaken within him. ॥4॥
ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੈ; ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
He remains absorbed in the fear of God, and does not stray outside it.
Who can estimate his worth? He remains lovingly attuned. ॥5॥
The Lord Himself unites him, and dispels his doubt.
By the Guru's grace, he attains the supreme status. ॥6॥
Service of the Guru is contemplation of the Word.
Subduing ego is the most excellent deed. ॥7॥
His chanting, austerity, self-discipline, scripture reading and Puranas —
says Nanak, are surrender to the Infinite Lord. ॥8॥6॥
He has taken forgiveness as his fast, and good conduct and contentment.
ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਨਾ ਜਮ ਦੋਖੰ ॥
Disease does not afflict him, nor the pain of death.
ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥੧॥
He is liberated, absorbed in God, who has no form or feature. ॥1॥
What fear can the true yogi have?
ਰੂਖਿ ਬਿਰਖਿ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Lord is in the trees and plants, inside the home and outside too. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The fearless yogi meditates on the Immaculate Lord.
Night and day he remains awake, lovingly attuned to the True One.
That yogi is pleasing to my mind. ॥2॥
He burns the noose of death with the fire of God.
He is rid of old age and death, and eradicates his pride.
He swims across, and saves his ancestors as well. ॥3॥
One who serves the True Guru is a yogi.
ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੈ; ਸੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who remains absorbed in the fear of God becomes fearless.
As is the one he serves, so does he become. ॥4॥
224: Meditating on the Fearless Name, a man becomes pure.
He makes the masterless have a Master; I am a sacrifice to him.
He is not reborn again; he sings the Lord's praises. ॥5॥
Inwardly and outwardly, he knows the One Lord.
Through the Guru's Word, he recognises his own self.
Through the True Word, he bears the insignia of the Lord's Court. ॥6॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
One who dies (to the self) through the Word dwells in his own true home.
He does not come or go in wandering; his hopes are ended.
Through the Guru's Word, the lotus of his heart blossoms forth. ॥7॥
Whoever is seen is driven by hope and despair,
by the poison of lust and anger, by hunger and thirst.
O Nanak, rare are those who are found detached. ॥8॥7॥
Meeting such a servant (of the Lord), peace is obtained;
pain is forgotten, and one obtains the True Lord. ॥1॥
Beholding his Blessed Vision, the intellect becomes perfect.
The dust of his feet is the bathing at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The eyes are content, attuned to the One Lord;
the tongue is purified by the sublime essence of the Lord. ॥2॥
True are one's actions, and service is deep within;
the mind is satisfied by the unseen, inscrutable Lord. ॥3॥
ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ; ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
Wherever I look, there I see the True One.
Without understanding, the unripe world argues and quarrels. ॥4॥
When the Guru instructs, understanding comes;
how rare is the Gurmukh who understands. ॥5॥
Show mercy and save us, O Protector Lord;
without understanding, people become beasts and demons. ॥6॥
The Guru has said that there is no other at all.
ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ; ਕਰਉ ਅਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
So tell me, whom should I see, and whom else should I worship? ॥7॥
For the sake of the saints, God has established the three worlds.
One who understands his own soul contemplates the essence of reality. ॥8॥
One in whose heart the True One dwells, in whom true love abides —
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥੯॥੮॥
prays Nanak, I am his servant. ॥9॥8॥
Brahma acted in pride, and did not understand (God's infinity).
Only when the calamity of the stolen Vedas fell upon him did he repent.
ਜਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰੇ; ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
When he remembered God in meditation, then his mind was convinced. ॥1॥
Such is the terrible pride in the world.
ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru eliminates the pride of whoever meets Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
King Bal was proud of his wealth;
he performed great sacrifices, puffed up with conceit.
Without consulting his guru, he had to go to the underworld. ॥2॥
Harichand gave in charity and earned public praise,
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ; ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥
but without the Guru he did not find the limits of the Inscrutable Lord.
The Lord Himself misleads, and He Himself gives understanding. ॥3॥
Through evil-mindedness, Harnaakhash became a wicked tyrant.
God, the all-pervading Lord, is the Destroyer of pride.
He showered His mercy and saved Prahlaad. ॥4॥
Raavan was deluded, foolish and unwise.
Sri Lanka was plundered, and he lost his head.
He was destroyed by pride, without love for the True Guru. ॥5॥
and Harnaakhash, who was torn apart with nails —
these demons were slain, for they did not practise devotional worship. ॥6॥
Slaying the demons, the Lord saved His saints. ॥7॥
He Himself, as the True Guru, contemplates the Word.
225: Through the love of duality, He slew the demons.
Through true devotion, He saves the Gurmukhs. ॥8॥
Sinking down, Duryodhan lost his honour;
he did not know the Lord, the Creator.
ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਖਿ ਪਚੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੯॥
One who makes the Lord's humble servant suffer shall himself suffer and rot. ॥9॥
Janmayjaa did not understand the Guru's Word;
deluded by doubt, how could he find peace?
Erring by a tiny bit, he later repented. ॥10॥
Kans the king, Kays and Chandoor had no equal,
ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਚੀਨਿਆ; ਅਪਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
but they did not recognise the Lord, and lost their honour.
Without the Lord of the universe, no one can be saved. ॥11॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਗਰਬੁ. ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Without the Guru, pride cannot be eradicated.
Following the Guru's teaching, one finds righteousness, patience and the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, singing the glories of God, His Name is received. ॥12॥9॥
I may anoint my limbs with perfume and sandalwood,
and dress up and wear silk and satin clothes,
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ; ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
but without the Lord's Name, where would I find peace? ॥1॥
What should I wear? In what clothes should I display myself?
ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ; ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Lord of the universe, how can I find peace? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਨੀ ਕੁੰਡਲ; ਗਲਿ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
I may wear earrings, and a pearl necklace around my neck;
my bed may be adorned with red covers and flowers;
but without the Lord of the universe, where can I search for peace? ॥2॥
I may have a beautiful woman with fascinating eyes;
she may decorate herself with the sixteen adornments, and be utterly dear to me;
but without meditating on the Lord of the universe, there is only continual ruin. ॥3॥
In my hearth and home, in my palace and on my soft and comfortable bed,
day and night, the gardener may scatter flowers;
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ; ਸੁ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥੪॥
but without the Lord's Name, the body is miserable. ॥4॥
armies, standard bearers, royal attendants and ostentatious displays —
without the Lord of the universe, these undertakings are all false. ॥5॥
I may call myself a Siddha, a miracle-worker, and summon wealth and supernatural powers;
I may place a crown on my head and a royal umbrella over it;
but without the Lord of the universe, where can I find the True One? ॥6॥
I may be called an emperor, a nobleman, a king;
I may order others about — but this is a false show.
Without the Guru's Word, one's affairs are not resolved. ॥7॥
Egotism and possessiveness are dispelled through the Guru's Word.
Through the Guru's teaching, I have come to know the Lord within my heart.
Prays Nanak, I seek Your sanctuary. ॥8॥10॥
One who serves the One Lord does not know any other.
He abandons the bitter afflictions of worldly pleasures.
ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Through love, he meets the True One, and becomes the truest of the true. ॥1॥
Such is the humble devotee of the Lord:
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
singing His praises, he meets Him, and his filth is washed away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The heart-lotus of the whole world is upside-down.
The fire of evil-mindedness is burning up the world.
Only one who contemplates the Guru's Word is saved. ॥2॥
The bumble bee, the moth, the elephant, the fish
and the deer — all die, suffering for their own actions.
Caught up in craving, man does not see the essence of reality. ॥3॥
The lover of women thinks only of lust;
anger destroys all who are given to corruption.
They lose their honour and their senses, forgetting the Name. ॥4॥
226: The self-willed one lets his consciousness waver in another's home.
A noose is around his neck, and he is entangled in worldly affairs.
The Gurmukh is released, singing the Lord's praises. ॥5॥
ਜਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਧਵਾ; ਪਰ ਕਉ ਦੇਈ ॥
As a widow gives her body to a stranger,
ਕਾਮਿ ਦਾਮਿ; ਚਿਤੁ ਪਰ ਵਸਿ ਸੇਈ ॥
putting her mind in another's control for lust or money,
ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ. ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ; ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
but without her husband she is never satisfied ॥6॥
One may read and read the scriptures and the Simritees,
read the Vedas and Puranas, and listen to their compositions;
ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ; ਮਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਟਾ ॥੭॥
but without being imbued with the Lord's essence, the mind dances in many ways. ॥7॥
As the song-bird thirsts with love for the rain-drop,
as the fish delights in water,
so Nanak is satisfied, drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord. ॥8॥11॥
ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
One who dies in stubborn self-torment is not counted (as approved).
He may wear religious robes and smear his body with ashes,
but forgetting the Name, he comes to regret it in the end. ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਖ ॥
Keep the Dear Lord in your mind, and find peace within your mind.
ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ; ਸਹਹਿ ਜਮ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Forgetting the Name, you shall have to endure the pain of death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
engrossed in Maya, the supreme status is far away.
When the Name is forgotten, all is false, utterly false. ॥2॥
Lances, marching bands, salutes on the throne —
these only increase craving, and one is overcome by lust.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਚੇ; ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
Without begging at the Lord's door, there is neither devotion nor the Name. ॥3॥
Through argument and ego, union with God is not obtained.
By giving your mind, you shall obtain the comforting Name.
In the love of duality there is painful ignorance. ॥4॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਦਮ ਕੇ; ਸਉਦਾ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਟ ॥
Without capital, one cannot buy goods at the shop;
without a ship, there is no way across the ocean;
without serving the Guru, there is loss upon loss. ॥5॥
ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ; ਜਿ ਵਾਟ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
Hail, hail to the one who shows the way;
ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ; ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
hail, hail to the one who lets one hear the Word;
ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ; ਜਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
hail, hail to the one who unites one in union (with the Lord). ॥6॥
ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Hail, hail to the One to whom this soul belongs.
Churning the Guru's Word, drink in the nectar.
The greatness of the Name is given by Your will. ॥7॥
Without the Name, how can I live, O mother?
Night and day, I keep chanting it; I remain in Your sanctuary.
O Nanak, imbued with the Name, honour is attained. ॥8॥12॥
Acting in ego, wearing religious robes, one does not know (the Lord).
Through the Guru, rare is the one whose mind is reconciled in devotion. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ; ਨਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Acting in ego, saying "I, I", the True Lord is not found.
ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ; ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When ego departs, the supreme status is obtained. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In ego, kings run about (against one another) again and again;
in ego they are ruined, and are born and die again and again. ॥2॥
Ego is overcome by contemplating the Guru's Word.
One who renounces the fickle intellect destroys the five (passions). ॥3॥
With the True One within, one comes to the home of poise;
knowing the Sovereign Lord, one attains the supreme state. ॥4॥
Truth becomes one's deed when the Guru dispels doubt;
one fixes one's attention on the home of the Fearless Lord. ॥5॥
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਣਾ; ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Those who die saying "I, I" — what do they gain?
ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ; ਸੋ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
One who meets the perfect Guru is rid of this conflict. ॥6॥
All that exists (in ego) is really nothing.
Obtaining spiritual wisdom, the Gurmukh sings the Lord's praises. ॥7॥
227: Ego binds people in bondage and makes them wander.
O Nanak, peace is obtained through devotion to the Lord. ॥8॥13॥
First, Brahma entered the house of death.
He went into the underworld, but could not find (the end of) the lotus of Brahm.
He did not accept (the Guru's) command; he was deluded by doubt. ॥1॥
Whoever is born is destroyed by death.
ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am protected by the Lord; I contemplate the Guru's Word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All the gods and goddesses are enticed by Maya.
ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਬਿਨੁ. ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Death does not let go of anyone without service to the Guru.
That Lord alone is imperishable, unseen and inscrutable. ॥2॥
Sultans, khans and kings shall not remain;
ਨਾਮਹੁ ਭੂਲੈ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਨਾ ॥
one who forgets the Name shall suffer the pain of death.
ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹਨਾ ॥੩॥
The Name is my only support; as You keep me, so I remain. ॥3॥
Chiefs and kings — none of them has a permanent abode.
Bankers die, having amassed the wealth of Maya.
ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
Give me the wealth of Your Ambrosial Name, O Lord. ॥4॥
none of them is seen to remain permanently in the world.
Irresistible death strikes the heads of the false. ॥5॥
Only the One Lord is permanent, the Truest of the true.
ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ; ਤਿਨਹਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
He who created and fashioned everything shall destroy it.
ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ; ਤਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
One who, as Gurmukh, meditates on Him is honoured. ॥6॥
Qazis, Shaykhs and fakirs in religious robes
call themselves great, but their bodies are in the pain of ego.
ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੭॥
Death does not spare them without the support of the True Guru. ॥7॥
The trap of death is on the tongue and the eyes;
death is in the ears, when one listens to words of poison.
Without the Word, people are plundered day and night. ॥8॥
Death cannot even look at one in whose heart the True One dwells through the Lord's Name,
ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਜੋਹਿ ਸਕੈ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
for he sings the glorious praises of the Lord.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in the Word. ॥9॥14॥
They speak the Truth, not an iota of falsehood.
The Gurmukhs walk in the way of the Lord's command.
They remain detached, in the sanctuary of the True Lord. ॥1॥
ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸੈ; ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
One who dwells in the true home is not touched by death.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ; ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The self-willed one comes and goes, in the pain of attachment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Drink deeply of the nectar, and speak the unspoken (praise of the Lord);
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ; ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
dwelling in the home of the self, the home of poise is found.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤੇ; ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
One who is intoxicated with the Lord's essence can call this peace. ॥2॥
Following the Guru's teaching, one's way is perfectly steady and never wavers.
Through the Guru's teaching, one chants the Name of the True Lord with intuitive ease.
One drinks in the nectar and churns out the essence of reality. ॥3॥
Beholding the True Guru, I have received his teaching.
I have offered my mind and body, and enshrined (the teaching) deep within.
I have realised His state and extent, and understood my own soul. ॥4॥
The Immaculate Name is the most excellent food.
The supreme swan (the pure soul) beholds the True Light of the Infinite Lord.
Wherever I look, there I see the One Lord. ॥5॥
One who remains detached, and does only true deeds,
ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
obtains the supreme status, serving at the Guru's feet.
ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਚੂਕੀ ਅਹੰ ਭ੍ਰਮਣੀ ॥੬॥
The mind is reconciled within itself, and the wandering of ego is ended. ॥6॥
ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ; ਕਉਣੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
Who has not been carried across in this way?
Through the Lord's praise, the saints and devotees have been saved.
228: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਏ; ਹਮ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
I have found God; I seek no other. ॥7॥
In the true Mansion, the Guru has revealed the Unseen Lord.
His Mansion is permanent; it is not touched by the shadow of Maya.
Content in the True One, doubt is dispelled. ॥8॥
ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Those within whose minds the True One dwells —
their company is obtained by the Gurmukh.
O Nanak, the True Name washes away the filth. ॥9॥15॥
ਰਾਮਿ ਨਾਮਿ; ਚਿਤੁ ਰਾਪੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
One whose consciousness is imbued with the Lord's Name —
behold his Blessed Vision early in the morning. ॥1॥
If you do not meditate on the Lord, it is your own misfortune.
ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In each and every age, my Lord God is the Giver. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
That humble being who meditates on the Lord through the Guru's teaching is perfect;
in his heart the unstruck melody resounds. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਜਨ; ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Those humble beings who love devotion to the Lord —
God has showered His mercy and saved them. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Those within whose hearts the Lord, Har, Har, dwells —
ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
beholding their Blessed Vision, peace is obtained. ॥4॥
The One Lord is pervading all beings;
the egotistical self-willed one wanders in reincarnation. ॥5॥
He alone understands, who finds the True Guru.
Subduing his ego, he finds (the Lord) through the Guru's Word. ॥6॥
ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਧਿ; ਕਿਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
How can one know the union of the lower (soul) with the higher (Lord)?
The Gurmukh obtains this union, and the mind is reconciled. ॥7॥
ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ; ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
I am a worthless sinner; bless me with virtue, O Lord.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
When God becomes merciful, O Nanak, His humble servants are carried across. ॥8॥16॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਿਉ ਗਾਈ ਕਉ ਗੋਇਲੀ; ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
As the herdsman guards and watches over his cows,
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪਾਲਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ; ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
so You cherish and protect us night and day, and bless us with peace of soul. ॥1॥
Protect me here and hereafter, O Lord, merciful to the meek.
I seek Your sanctuary; bless me with Your glance of grace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ. ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ; ਰਖੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Wherever I look, You are pervading there; protect me, O Protector.
ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ. ਭੁਗਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ; ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
You are the Giver, and You are the Enjoyer; You are the support of the breath of life. ॥2॥
ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ, ਅਧ ਊਰਧੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Driven by past deeds, one falls low and rises high, without contemplation of spiritual wisdom.
ਬਿਨੁ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨ. ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
Without the praise of the Lord of the universe, darkness is not dispelled. ॥3॥
ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਤ. ਹਮ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਲੋਭੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
I have seen the world being destroyed by greed and ego.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਚੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
Serving the Guru, God is found, and the true door of liberation. ॥4॥
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ. ਅਪਾਰ ਕੋ; ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
The Mansion of the Infinite Lord is within the home of the self; He is beyond the beyond.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
Without the Word, nothing is stable; through understanding, peace is obtained. ॥5॥
ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ, ਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਆ; ਫਾਸਹਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
What did you bring, and what will you take away? You are caught in the trap of death.
ਡੋਲੁ ਬਧਾ ਕਸਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ; ਆਕਾਸਿ ਪਤਾਲਾ ॥੬॥
Like the bucket tied tight to the rope, you go up to the sky and down to the underworld. ॥6॥
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching, the Name is not forgotten, and honour is obtained with intuitive ease.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
The treasure of the Word is deep within; meeting Him, self-conceit is lost. ॥7॥
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ; ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
When God bestows His glance of grace, one merges in His embrace of virtue.
ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ. ਨ ਚੂਕਈ; ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੭॥
O Nanak, this union is never broken; one earns the true profit. ॥8॥1॥17॥
229: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝਿ ਲੇ; ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
By the Guru's grace, understand, and then you will be released:
ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ; ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
in each and every heart is the Name of the Immaculate Lord; He is my Lord and Master. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ. ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Without the Guru's Word, no one is released; see this and reflect on it.
ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You may perform hundreds of thousands of rituals, but without the Guru there is only darkness. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅੰਧੇ ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ; ਕਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
What can one say to those who are blind and without wisdom?
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਈ; ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਰਬਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
Without the Guru, the path cannot be seen; how can one make it through? ॥2॥
ਖੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਖਰਾ ਕਹੈ; ਖਰੇ. ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
One calls the counterfeit genuine, and does not know the worth of the genuine.
ਅੰਧੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਰਖੂ; ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
The blind one is called an appraiser — this is the wondrous way of this Dark Age. ॥3॥
ਸੂਤੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਕਹੈ; ਜਾਗਤ ਕਉ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
The sleeper is said to be awake, and the one who is awake is said to be asleep.
ਜੀਵਤ ਕਉ. ਮੂਆ ਕਹੈ; ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਰੋਤਾ ॥੪॥
The living are said to be dead, and none weep for the (spiritually) dead. ॥4॥
ਆਵਤ ਕਉ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਹੈ; ਜਾਤੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
One who is coming (to the Lord) is said to be going, and one who has gone is said to have come.
ਪਰ ਕੀ ਕਉ. ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਹੈ; ਅਪੁਨੋ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
What belongs to others one calls one's own, and what is one's own does not please one. ॥5॥
ਮੀਠੇ ਕਉ ਕਉੜਾ ਕਹੈ; ਕੜੂਏ ਕਉ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
The sweet is called bitter, and the bitter is called sweet.
ਰਾਤੇ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਐਸਾ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੬॥
People slander the one imbued (with the Lord's love) — such is what I have seen in this Dark Age. ॥6॥
ਚੇਰੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
People serve the maidservant (Maya), and do not see the Lord and Master.
ਪੋਖਰੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੀਐ; ਮਾਖਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਰੀਸੈ ॥੭॥
Churning the water of a pond, no butter is produced. ॥7॥
ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਜੋ ਅਰਥਾਇ ਲੇਇ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
One who understands the meaning of this verse is my Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ; ਸੋ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੮॥
O Nanak, one who knows his own self is one with the Infinite, Boundless Lord. ॥8॥
ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
He Himself is all-pervading, and He Himself misleads people.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੀਐ; ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥੨॥੧੮॥
By the Guru's grace one understands that God is contained in all. ॥9॥2॥18॥
Gauri Guareri · Ashtpadis · Guru Amar Das
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The love of duality is the impurity of the mind.
Deluded by doubt, people come and go. ॥1॥
The impurity of the self-willed one never goes away,
ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ. ਨ ਭੀਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
as long as he is not drenched with the Word and the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All the attachment to the visible world is impurity;
one dies and is born, over and over again. ॥2॥
Impurity is in fire, air and water;
impure is the food that is eaten. ॥3॥
In impurity, neither rituals nor worship are of any avail.
Imbued with the Name, the mind becomes immaculate. ॥4॥
Serving the True Guru, impurity departs;
ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ; ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੫॥
one does not die or take birth, and death does not devour him. ॥5॥
Let anyone study and examine the Shastras and Simritees:
ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
without the Name, no one is liberated. ॥6॥
ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Throughout the four ages, the Name is supreme, through contemplating the Word.
In this Dark Age, the Gurmukh crosses over. ॥7॥
The True Lord does not die; He does not come or go.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains absorbed in Him. ॥8॥1॥
Service through the Guru is the support of the breath of life.
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
Keep the Dear Lord enshrined in your heart.
Through the Guru, one is honoured at the True Door. ॥1॥
O pandit, study the Lord, and renounce corruption.
Through the Guru, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
230: Through the Guru, ego departs from within.
Through the Guru, filth does not cling.
Through the Guru, the Name comes to dwell in the mind. ॥2॥
Through the Guru, one's deeds and righteous conduct are in Truth.
The Gurmukh burns away ego and duality.
The Gurmukh, imbued with the Name, finds peace. ॥3॥
Instruct your own mind, and understand Him.
You instruct others, but no one listens.
Through the Guru, understand, and you shall be at peace forever. ॥4॥
The self-willed one is full of hypocrisy and great cleverness.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਸੁ ਥਾਇ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Whatever he does is not accepted.
He comes and goes, and finds no place of rest. ॥5॥
The self-willed one does rituals, with great pride.
ਬਗ ਜਿਉ; ਲਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
Like a crane, he sits in meditation day after day.
When death seizes him, only then does he regret. ॥6॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Without serving the True Guru, there is no liberation.
By the Guru's grace, one meets the Lord.
The Guru is the Giver throughout the four ages. ॥7॥
For the Gurmukh, the Name is social status, honour and glory.
He has cut down and cast away (Maya,) the daughter of the ocean.
O Nanak, without the Name, all cleverness is false. ॥8॥2॥
ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ; ਪੜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ॥
Study the religion of this age, O brothers.
All understanding is obtained from the perfect Guru:
here and hereafter, the Lord's Name is our companion. ॥1॥
Study the Lord, and contemplate Him in your mind.
By the Guru's grace, wash away your filth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He is not found by argument and debate.
The mind and body become insipid in the love of duality.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Through the Guru's Word, one is lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ॥2॥
This world is polluted with ego.
ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵੈ; ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
One bathes daily at sacred shrines, but ego does not depart.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ; ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
Without meeting the Guru, death torments him. ॥3॥
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
That humble being is true who subdues his ego.
Through the Guru's Word, he slays the five (passions).
He saves himself, and saves all his generations as well. ॥4॥
The Actor (the Lord) has staged the show of attachment to Maya.
The blind self-willed ones remain clinging to it.
The Gurmukhs remain detached, lovingly attuned to the Lord. ॥5॥
The wearer of religious robes puts on many disguises,
but craving is within him, and he wanders in ego.
He does not understand himself, and he loses the game of life. ॥6॥
Wearing religious robes, one acts cleverly,
but is utterly deluded by doubt and attachment to Maya.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
Without serving the Guru, one suffers terrible pain. ॥7॥
Those who are imbued with the Name are forever detached.
Even as householders, they are lovingly attuned to the True Lord.
O Nanak, those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate. ॥8॥3॥
Brahma is considered the source of the study of the Vedas;
ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ; ਦੇਵ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
from him came the gods, enticed by attachment and craving.
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮੇ; ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
They wander in the three qualities, and do not dwell in their own true home. ॥1॥
The Lord has saved me; He has led me to meet the True Guru.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He has implanted devotional worship of the Lord's Name within me, night and day. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The bani of Brahma keeps one in the three qualities and the entanglement (of Maya).
ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ; ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਾ ॥
Reading it, they argue and debate, and are struck on the head by the Messenger of Death.
